purpose: Bind one interoperable recipient-envelope suite and one misuse-resistant content-encryption suite for the first Rust Devnet trial without claiming production security approval.

content_encryption.nonce_rule: Generate one cryptographically random 24-byte nonce for every encryption under a content key and reject any detected key-and-nonce reuse.

recipient_envelope.sender_authentication_boundary: HPKE Base mode does not authenticate the sender. Grant and reissue authorization are established separately by the exact Solana signing-key binding, transaction signature, program checks, and Propagation Policy.

commitments.rule: A commitment is the SHA-256 digest of the exact domain separator followed by the exact deterministic bytes; the domain and algorithm are part of identity.

serialization.unknown_fields: reject unless a successor profile explicitly defines compatibility
serialization.schema_version_field: required in every ciphertext and envelope header

randomness.source_requirement: operating-system cryptographically secure random generator through an implementation binding
forbidden_sources: deterministic test RNG outside declared fixtures

key_boundaries.content_key: 32 random bytes per Encryption Epoch; never stored on chain or in durable storage as plaintext
key_boundaries.recipient_private_key: held only by the recipient-side key-custody boundary
key_boundaries.solana_signing_key: used only for Solana authorization and never as an HPKE recipient key or content-encryption key
key_boundaries.reissue: ordinary reissue rewraps the same content key for a new accepted recipient encryption-key binding; suspected compromise requires a successor Encryption Epoch

failure_rules: fail closed on profile, artifact, epoch, recipient, key-binding, policy, or commitment mismatch
fail closed on unsupported algorithm identifiers or profile versions
never return partial plaintext before authentication succeeds
residue: Rust library and exact version remain implementation-binding choices.
Known-answer vectors, fuzzing, side-channel review, zeroization proof, dependency review, and independent security review remain conformance obligations.
This profile is selected only for the first Devnet trial and is not production cryptographic approval.
claim_limit: Candidate test-only cryptographic profile values; no implementation, security certification, key creation, encryption, transaction, deployment, or production authorization.
